# Manager Behavioral and Project Deep Dive

[← SoFi](../README.md) · [Every SoFi question](../../sofi.md) · [Read it on TrueInterview](https://trueinterview.io/study/manager-behavioral-and-project-deep-dive)

`bq` `conflict` `deep-dive` `impact` `leadership`

---

## Requirements

Prepare STAR examples and technical explanations for questions including:

- Tell me about a time you failed by missing a deadline and needed to keep stakeholders informed.
- Describe a choice in which you represented the end user despite giving up an ideal technical implementation.
- Explain a technical solution you handled beyond your initial responsibilities, why you accepted it, and the effect it produced.
- Tell me about a conflict with significantly more senior colleagues and how you settled it while preserving the relationship.
- Describe a project that you considered especially engaging.
- Share an operational example or an improvement you made to a process.
- Describe a collaboration experience in which you assigned some of the work to other people.
- Tell me about a situation where another team was expected to deliver something but failed to do so.
- Why do you want to join SoFi?
- Which project are you proudest of?
- Which project presented the greatest challenge?
- What do you consider your most significant failure?
- Teach the interviewer about something you learned recently.

## Notes

In several rounds, every response after the opening question is expected to tie back to one project.

Manager interviews may include questions about the type of role you want next and whether the team genuinely provides that level of responsibility.

Limited evidence of project impact can lead to rejection even if the coding and system-design rounds seem satisfactory.
